clean_token_metadata_replace_non_ascii: clean token metadata by replacing non-ASCII escape sequences like backslash xc4 and xa0 in token strings
clean_token_metadata_remove_prefix: clean token metadata by removing all prefix tokens before the first token containing a colon
clean_token_metadata_strip_and_filter: clean token metadata by stripping whitespace and filtering out empty tokens from the list
clean_token_metadata_convert_logprob: clean token metadata by converting token_logprob values to strings in each metadata dictionary
clean_token_metadata_full_pipeline: clean a list of token tuples by replacing escapes, removing prefixes, stripping whitespace, and converting logprobs
